summary: Polyrizon Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 8, 2026, attaching a press release regarding clinical progress for its NASARIX (PL-14) trial, including securing three U.S. clinical sites for a seasonal allergic rhinitis study. The filing does not involve any M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation corporate action. It is a routine foreign private issuer report on clinical trial progress. No deal terms, premiums, or transaction dates are provided. This is not a special situation; it represents ordinary operational updates.
